items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: And so I got a band together, George Brunus. George Brunus. First time I heard George in person. Bill Bourgeois, a fella by the name of Turk on the bass, and Bowman.

ctx.x: In other words, it was a cobweb place. Yeah, I heard you there. Down in the cellar. And so I got a band together, George Brunus. George Brunus. First time I heard George in person. Bill Bourgeois, a fella by the name of Turk on the bass, and Bowman. I don't know if you know Bowman, Red Bowman, he played piano.
Yeah, yeah, the pianist. He was from New York, I guess.

items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Would you like to go to work with Sharky? I says, what's the money? What's the price? Everything was agreed. So we went to Nick's

ctx.x: How long was Muggsy with you there too?

Uh, I got Muggsy with Lewis. He was with Lewis for about seven years. He was with, uh, Ray Miller's band down the, uh, Sherman. And I went to him and I says, uh, I told Lewis, I says, I got a good man down there, Sherman. He says, well, if you recommend him, he must be good. He says, I'll take him without hearing him. I says, oh, no. I says, you're going to hear him first. He says, I don't want me taking him. So Muggsy auditioned for him and he liked Muggsy. Muggsy stayed with him for seven years. And, uh, then…
